## Resolved mutable: gm-empty-invariant-reason

invariant: live-read gm-client (spool/daemon, no SessionEventMap) and tool-gm (ctx.tools.register of opaque gm JSON, no owned session events). cmdline empty installer comment form is the matching companion. Neither package owns a session event or mutable product relation to check.

## Resolved mutable: gm-native-tool-postcondition-2

Live-verified in three stages: (1) node -e import of @freddie/freddie-tool-gm and @freddie/freddie-gm-client from apps/cli both resolve and export {apply,inject,name} / {Gm,default}. (2) buildGmTools(fakeGm) produced all 8 typed tool definitions; executed gm_codesearch and gm_exec_js against a fake gm.call, confirming correct body-shape mapping and exec_js's rawBody `timeoutMs=<ms>\n<code>` prefix construction. (3) Verified every verb-name mapping (instruction, codesearch, recall, prd-add, mutable-add, transition, exec_js, git_finalize) matches gm's real mixed dash/underscore convention (previously wrong via a blanket replaceAll, fixed to explicit `verb:` fields per tool). (4) Full composition boot: FREDDIE_HOME=<isolated temp dir> GM_HOME_DIR=1 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=dummy pnpm freddie --profile headless "say hi" -- entire plugin tree activated with no registration error (gm-client + tool-gm + mcp-gm all mounted), reaching the real LLM auth call before failing on the deliberately-invalid key -- proving ctx.tools.register() ran successfully for all 8 new tools during activation, since a registration-time schema/duplicate-name error would have surfaced as a boot failure before reaching auth.

## Resolved mutable: gm-native-tool-precondition-2

Read docs/cookbook/adding-a-tool.md and packages/shell/tool-bash/src/index.js (the reference three-package example) before authoring packages/gm/tool-gm/src/{index.js,verbs.js}. Confirmed defineTool's real parameters/output.schema/execute contract from both.

## Resolved mutable: native-gm-tool-postcondition

postcondition discharged live against THIS session transcript, not stale session-41730140. Decompressed ~/.freddie/sessions/--C-dev-deepseek-harness--/session-b883a0dd-7537-4905-b82a-0225b9a951ba/session.jsonl.zstd (106 zstd frames, 361 events, 45 tool/call). tool/call names: skill=1 pwsh=4 mcp__gm__gm=29 read=11. Native gm verbs used: instruction, phase-status, exec_js, scan_deps, codesearch, git_status, git_show, git_diff, mutable-resolve -- all via mcp__gm__gm. The 4 pwsh bodies are: (1) gm-skill boot probe reading .status.json/.turn-summary.json, (2) ConvertFrom-Json of an already-written instruction OUT file, (3) FREDDIE_* env + port inventory, (4) ConvertFrom-Json of an exec_js OUT file. None write .gm/exec-spool/in/<verb>. The 4 transcript lines matching exec-spool/in are request/header (system prompt), skill-load result, instruction result, and mutables.yml read -- not pwsh writes.

## Resolved mutable: postcondition-runner-source-needs-owned-restart

exec_js 1788949213381 plugHead=980d270; live .status.json pid=23736 predates that binary. packages/gm/README.md documents AGENTPLUG_HOME isolates a local runner. Machine-wide process picks source up only on next owned restart.
